summary.text: Werner Horn is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House representing Merrimack 2 from 2014 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Horn assumed office in the New Hampshire House on December 3, 2014, and left office on December 1, 2020, having not run for re-election in 2020.
He was assigned to the Transportation Committee in the 2015 and 2017 legislative sessions and, in 2019 and 2020, to the House Finance Committee and its Finance - Division II committee.
In 2018 incumbents Dave Testerman and Horn defeated Democrats Scott Burns and Delaney Carrier in the Merrimack 2 general election.
Horn sought the Republican nomination in Merrimack 3 in 2024 but was defeated in the primary by Bryan Morse and Ernesto Leonardo Gonzalez.
On September 8, 2026, he and Mike Visconti defeated incumbent Gonzalez in the Republican primary for the seat.
